entities.name: Nekrataal
entities.description: A type of human assassin from Dominaria, said to be horrors freed by Kaervek on Jamuraa.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: Called the Nekrataal one of the horrors Kaervek freed.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: Land where the horrors were freed.

relations.note: Freed them on Jamuraa according to Jolrael.
relations.quote: Jolrael called the Nekrataal one of the horrors that Kaervek freed on Jamuraa
